turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will call Estella at the door.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will call Estella at the door.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall be in there, she said, and instructed to knock when she comes.
turns.speech: I shall be in here. Knock when she comes.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go and call Estella at the door.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go and call Estella at the door.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham told Pip that she would remain there, waiting for her return. She then instructed him that he could go ahead, my boy.
turns.speech: I shall be here, awaiting her return. You may proceed, my boy.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go and call Estella now.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go and call Estella now.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham shall wait there, ensconced in her memories and regrets, until she returns. Pip may go.
turns.speech: I shall wait here, ensconced in my memories and regrets, until she returns. You may go, Pip.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go now to call Estella.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go now to call Estella.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Go, Pip, and do not dawdle. Bring Estella to Miss Havisham, so she may observe his interaction.
turns.speech: Go, my boy, and do not dawdle. Bring Estella to me, so I may observe your interaction.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham. Pip will go to find Estella right away.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham. I will go to find Estella right away.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Pip left then, for Miss Havisham awaited Estella.
turns.speech: Leave now, Pip. Miss Havisham awaits Estella.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip will hurry to find Estella, Miss Havisham told her.
turns.speech: I will hurry to find Estella, Miss Havisham.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham wondered how long it would take for the boy to fetch Estella. Let him suffer a little, as she had suffered.
turns.speech: I wonder how long it will take for that boy to fetch Estella. Let him suffer a little, as I have suffered.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip would go quickly to find Estella, Miss Havisham.
turns.speech: I will go quickly to find Estella, Miss Havisham.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham wondered if the boy knew what it meant to wait, to feel the hands of time stand still.
turns.speech: I wonder if the boy knows what it means to wait, to feel the hands of time stand still.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip will go now, Miss Havisham, to find Estella as she asked.
turns.speech: I will go now, Miss Havisham, to find Estella as you asked.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Pip will return with her, and when he does, he will see what it means to be frozen in time.
turns.speech: You will return with her, and when you do, you will see what it means to be frozen in time.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Pip would return quickly, Miss Havisham, and bring Estella back as she wished.
turns.speech: I will return quickly, Miss Havisham, and bring Estella back as you wish.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham was curious to see the effect it had on Pip. She told him to wait for Estella, just as she had waited for so long.
turns.speech: Pip, I am curious to see the effect it has on you. Wait for Estella, just as I have waited for so long.

turns.speaker: Pip
turns.text: Yes, Miss Havisham, Pip will wait for Estella as she says.
turns.speech: Yes, Miss Havisham, I will wait for Estella as you say.

turns.speaker: Miss Havisham
turns.text: Miss Havisham will see how Pip fares while he waits. And she will see if he, like others, can be molded to her desires.
turns.speech: I will see how Pip fares while he waits. And I will see if he, like others, can be molded to my desires.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip who it was.

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he was Pip, ma’am.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was Pip?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip informed Miss Havisham that he was Mr. Pumblechook’s boy, ma’am. Come—to play.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip to come nearer; let her look at him. Come close.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was not afraid of a woman who had never seen the sun since he was born?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip replied that he was not.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he knew what she touched here?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he did, ma’am.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip what she touched?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that she touched her heart.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham exclaimed that it was broken!

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip that she was tired. She wanted diversion, and she had done with men and women. Play.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham said that she sometimes had sick fancies, and she had a sick fancy that she wanted to see some play. There, there! with an impatient movement of the fingers of her right hand; play, play, play!

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham asked Pip if he was sullen and obstinate?

opening.speaker: Pip
opening.text: Pip told Miss Havisham that he was not, ma’am, he was very sorry for her, and very sorry he could not play just now. If she complained of him he would get into trouble with his sister, so he would do it if he could; but it was so new here, and so strange, and so fine,—and melancholy—.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham remarked that it was so new to him, so old to her; so strange to him, so familiar to her; so melancholy to both of them! She asked Pip to call Estella.

opening.speaker: Miss Havisham
opening.text: Miss Havisham told Pip to call Estella. At the door.
